name: Pocopson
description: Schooner barge that foundered in 1936 and was later dynamited, a debris field in about 15 m just off the Monmouth County shore that is dived from a boat.

name: Vega
description: Small Staten Island auto ferry that capsized under tow in 1961 and lies in about 17 m off the Monmouth County shore; a boat dive.

name: Barge No. 10
description: Inverted derrick barge that makes a popular shallow boat dive in about 18 m off Sea Girt.

name: Matt Turecamo
description: Former Army tug sunk as part of the Sea Girt Reef in 1996, resting in about 24 m with its deck near 20 m; a boat dive.

name: Mohawk
description: Clyde-Mallory passenger liner lost in a 1935 collision, lying in about 24 m off Mantoloking; a boat dive.

name: Pinta
description: Dutch freighter sunk in a 1963 collision, now a broken wreck on its side in about 26 m off Monmouth County; a boat dive.

name: Tolten
description: Chilean freighter torpedoed in 1942, lying in about 29 m off Barnegat; a boat dive.

name: Coney Island
description: Former New York sludge tanker sunk in 1987 as part of the Shark River Reef, in about 38 m; a boat dive.

name: Captain Bart
description: Navy gasoline barge sunk in 2000 on the Shark River Reef, lying on its side in about 40 m; a boat dive.

name: Stolt Dagali
description: Stern half of a Norwegian tanker lost in a 1964 collision, in about 40 m some 18 miles off Manasquan; a boat dive.

name: Arundo
description: Dutch freighter torpedoed in 1942, a large wreck in roughly 43 m about 18 miles offshore; a boat dive.

name: USS Algol
description: Navy attack transport sunk as an artificial reef in 1991, lying in about 44 m on the Shark River Reef; a boat dive.

name: Lillian
description: Freighter lost in a 1939 collision, a collapsed wreck in about 46 m far offshore; a technical boat dive.

name: Sea Girt Reef
description: State artificial reef of sunken tugs, barges and subway cars in about 20 m off Sea Girt; a boat dive.

name: Axel Carlson Reef
description: State artificial reef of sunken vessels and concrete in about 24 m off Mantoloking, south of Manasquan Inlet; a boat dive.

name: Shark River Reef
description: Offshore artificial reef of Navy vessels and tugs in about 38 m, roughly 15 miles east of Shark River Inlet; a boat dive.

name: Barnegat Light Reef
description: Inshore state artificial reef of tugs and a sunken submarine hull in about 17 m off Barnegat Inlet; a boat dive.

name: Shark River Inlet
description: Jetty and bridge shore dive at the Belmar and Avon inlet, with rocky walls to about 5 m, best at slack tide.

name: Manasquan Inlet
description: Rock jetty shore dive between Manasquan and Point Pleasant, to about 9 m, with strong current and heavy boat traffic.

name: Barnegat Inlet
description: Shore dive along the north jetty at Barnegat Light, to about 14 m, with strong current and surf.
